API / interface changes
- No code/API change in this issue.
- Documentation surface changes only:
  - repo vars
  - PR label semantics (`ai:resolver-escalated`)
  - PR-body/state marker semantics
  - workflow/log marker semantics
  - branch rebuild audit record semantics

Conflicts detected
- Current docs are stale versus the codebase:
  - `docs/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal.md` still says Phase 1 shipped and later phases are deferred.
  - `docs/completed/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md` still presents Phases 2-6 as follow-up work.
  - `docs/plans/...` and `docs/completed/...` are still duplicate full documents.
- `BRANCH_REBUILD_AUDIT_V1` is not present as a literal runtime marker/string in code. The implemented artifact is the branch rebuild audit v1 record/schema (`branch_rebuild_audit.v1.json` / `BranchRebuildAuditV1`). The docs should reflect the actual implementation name instead of inventing a nonexistent literal marker.

Potential risks / edge cases
- `README.md` has two separate variable tables; updating only one will leave user docs inconsistent.
- `ai:resolver-escalated` is applied to the final PR issue object, not the tracking issue; wording should make that scope clear.
- `AUTOFIX_RESOLVER_RETRY_STATE_V1` is a PR-body block, while `FINGERPRINT_TIER_DOWNGRADED_V1` / `FINGERPRINT_QUARANTINED_V1` are workflow log markers; the docs should not blur those surfaces.
- `docs/completed/...` should remain the canonical source because other repo docs/tests already reference that path; `docs/plans/...` should become a stub, not a second canonical copy.
- Keep the implementation inside the scoped docs only; do not touch runtime code, tests, `CLAUDE.md`, or the postmortem.

Testing considerations
- Docs-only validation; no new tests and no test-file edits expected.
- After editing, run text-level sanity checks such as:
  - grep for all six new repo vars in `README.md` and `agents.md`
  - grep for `ai:resolver-escalated`, `AUTOFIX_RESOLVER_RETRY_STATE_V1`, `FINGERPRINT_TIER_DOWNGRADED_V1`, `FINGERPRINT_QUARANTINED_V1`, and the branch rebuild audit wording in the updated docs
  - grep targeted files for stale phrases like `later phases remain follow-up work` / `Phase 1 shipped on this branch`
  - confirm `docs/plans/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md` is a short pointer and `docs/completed/...` remains the only full canonical plan doc
